GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 370.05 (14 Nov 45) GC
(SCAPIN - 278)
APO 500
14 November 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : THE IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Request for Permission to Repatriate Chinese Laborers on Board "hokusen-maru".
1. Favorable action has already been taken in regard to: approving request to load 1,055 Chinese on Hokusen Maru; and to furnish guards aboard vessel.
2. Further information and instructions regarding voyage of subject vessel was furnished Imperial Japanese Government in Memo, this headquarters file AG 560 (14 Nov 45) GC, subject: "Substitution of Ship Sailing for Shanghai", dated 14 November 1945.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
